output.answer: Per Amazon's most recent annual report (Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, filed February 6, 2026), the significant subsidiaries listed in Exhibit 21.1 are Amazon.com Services LLC (Delaware), Amazon.com Sales, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Data Services, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Web Services, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Technologies, Inc. (Nevada), Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC (Nevada), Amazon US Services LLC (Delaware), A100 ROW, Inc. (Delaware) and Day One Insurance, Inc. (Arizona) — each 100% owned. Beyond these legal entities, Amazon's best-known operating subsidiaries include Amazon Web Services (AWS), Zoox (self-driving cars), Kuiper Systems (satellite internet), Amazon Lab126 (hardware R&D), Ring, Twitch, IMDb, Whole Foods Market, One Medical, Audible, Wondery and Amazon MGM Studios (which includes Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer). Amazon most recently added India-based fintech lender Axio, an acquisition completed in September 2025. Note the 10-K names only 'significant' subsidiaries; Amazon owns many smaller legal entities not individually listed.
caveats: Exhibit 21.1 of the 10-K lists only 'significant' subsidiaries — Amazon owns many additional legal entities that are not individually named, so the official list is not exhaustive.

Consumer brand names (Ring, Twitch, Zoox, Whole Foods Market, One Medical, Audible) are operating businesses held through various legal entities; their brand names do not necessarily match the subsidiary legal names in SEC filings.

Subsidiary structures change with acquisitions and reorganizations (e.g., the Axio acquisition completed September 2025; Amazon announced in January 2026 it would close all Amazon Go and Amazon Fresh physical stores), so the roster may shift before the next 10-K.

passages.quote: The company has multiple subsidiaries, including [Amazon Web Services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Web_Services) (AWS), which provides cloud computing; [Zoox](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoox_\(company\)), a [self-driving car](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Self-driving_car) division; satellite Internet provider [Kuiper Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuiper_Systems); and [Amazon Lab126](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Lab126), a computer hardware [R&D](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R&D) provider. Other subsidiaries include [Ring](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ring_\(company\)), [Twitch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitch_\(service\)), [IMDb](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IMDb), and grocer [Whole Foods Market](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whole_Foods_Market). Amazon distributes downloadable and streaming content through its [Amazon Prime Video](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Prime_Video), [MGM+](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MGM+), [Amazon Music](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Music), [Twitch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitch_\(service\)), [Audible](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audible_\(service\)), and [Wondery](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wondery)[\[9\]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_\(company\)#cite_note-10) units through its Entertainment division. It publishes books through its publishing arm, [Amazon Publishing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Publishing); produces and distributes film and television content through [Amazon MGM Studios](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_MGM_Studios), including the [Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer) studio; and owns Brilliance Audio and [Audible](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audible_\(service\)), which produce and distribute [audiobooks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audiobook), respectively. Amazon produces consumer electronics, most notably [Kindle](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Kindle) e-readers, [Echo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Echo) devices, [Fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Fire) tablets, and [Fire](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Fire_TV) TVs.

output.question: What are Amazon's subsidiaries?

key_facts.fact: Amazon's FY2025 Form 10-K Exhibit 21.1 lists nine significant subsidiaries, each 100% owned: Amazon.com Services LLC (Delaware), Amazon.com Sales, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Data Services, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Web Services, Inc. (Delaware), Amazon Technologies, Inc. (Nevada), Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC (Nevada), Amazon US Services LLC (Delaware), A100 ROW, Inc. (Delaware), and Day One Insurance, Inc. (Arizona).

Amazon's operating subsidiaries/units include Amazon Web Services (cloud computing), Zoox (self-driving cars), Kuiper Systems (satellite internet), Amazon Lab126 (hardware R&D), Ring, Twitch, IMDb, Whole Foods Market, Amazon MGM Studios (including Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer), Audible, Wondery, Brilliance Audio and One Medical.
Amazon completed its acquisition of Bengaluru-based non-banking lender Axio in September 2025, adding an India direct-lending business (RBI cleared the deal in June 2025).

In January 2026 Amazon announced it would close all Amazon Go and Amazon Fresh physical stores (57 Fresh and 15 Go locations), shifting focus to same-day delivery and Whole Foods Market — some converting to Whole Foods stores.
